data.content: Hi Asha! I'm Meera, your manager here on Influora.
Check my set-up: 0-3s · Talking to camera by the window

[Photo check]
Shot: "0-3s · Talking to camera by the window"
Photo check saw: I can see you're in a bedroom, window light from behind you, a bright window behind you, phone below your eyes, framed chest up.
Steps:
1) Window behind you: Change where the phone points so the window moves to the side, close or cover the curtain, or add your own light on your face. Don't just make the whole video darker, or your face can turn into a dark shape. Wide shots are the hardest here.
2) Eye-level phone: Keep the phone at your eye level. It gives a neutral view and easy eye contact, the best default for interviews, teaching and talking straight to camera.
3) Talking head by a window: Lens: 1x Main. Distance: 0.8-1m. Framing: Chest up. EV: +0.5. Stabilization: Tripod (stabilization off).
Looking good: The framing suits this kind of shot. The background is clean and doesn't pull the eye away.
Can't tell from one photo: A photo can't tell me how your audio sounds. I can't see the room behind the phone.
I asked: Can you move to a different spot for this shot? (Yes, I can move / No, fixed spot)

Set-up check karo: 3-6s · Khaane ka close-up

[Photo check]
Shot: "3-6s · Khaane ka close-up"
Photo check saw: Mujhe dikh raha hai: aap kitchen mein ho, tube light upar se aa rahi hai, background busy hai, phone eye level pe hai, framing waist up hai.
Steps:
1) Kitchen ka setup: Jo light aapne chuni hai, usi ki taraf face karo, aur ceiling light aur cabinet ke neeche wali light ko alag-alag control karo. Mixed light colours, chamakti tiles aur steel, aur upar ki lights ki shadows check karo.
2) Kitchen ya corridor ki lights: Kitchen aur corridor mein aksar warm aur cool lights mix hoti hain. Face ke liye warm ya cool mein se koi colour chuno aur clash karne wali lights off karo, ya unhe background mein jaanboojhkar colour accent ki tarah rakho.
3) Khaane ka close-up: Lens: 1x Main. Doori: 0.3m (macro). Frame: Macro. EV: -0.3. Agar aapke camera app mein Pro video mode hai: FPS 25; shutter 1/50; ISO under 800; white balance 3200K. Agar aapke phone mein OIS (optical stabilisation) hai: phone steady OIS only.
Looking good: Phone eye level pe hai, isliye eye contact natural lagta hai.
Can't tell from one photo: Frame ke bahar ki light, jaise side mein rakha lamp, photo mein nahi dikhti.
I asked: Ceiling ya tube light ke alawa koi aur light hai jo aap hila sako? (Ek lamp / Ring light / Sirf tube ya ceiling light / Aur kuch nahi)
